title: Kibbeh Rawza
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish consisting of ground meat and bulgur mixture, served raw with a side of rawza sauce. This variation is a refreshing twist on the traditional kibbeh, perfect for warm weather.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine kibbeh, bulgur, onion, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Add the rawza to the bowl and mix until the ingredients are well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, shape the mixture into small patties or balls.
Serve the kibbeh rawza with rawza sauce for dipping.
